music_play_local.description: Play local FLAC music by mood, genre, artist, album, playlist, or specific song title

music_play_online.description: Play something new, surprising, obscure, non-local, or queue online tracks for a vibe

music_control.description: Pause, resume, skip, previous, stop, shuffle, volume, or check what song is playing

audio_control.description: Change Windows system volume up/down/percent, mute/unmute audio or microphone

launch_app.description: Open or launch a Windows desktop application, tool, or game

agy_status.description: Check what Antigravity is currently doing, whether it finished, or how much longer it will take

ask_agy.description: Ask Antigravity specifically, or delegate a deep, multi-file, or long-horizon coding/research task to Antigravity

screen_context.description: Look at or capture the current screen, window, or visible error to explain or troubleshoot it

web_search.description: Look up live info, current news, prices, game wikis, or recent real-world facts

conversation.description: Casual chat, quick factual questions, explanations, or general reasoning
